instruction_text: Route voice calls from customers who select the Spanish-language menu option and request billing assistance to agents with Spanish and billing skills, at priority 2, Monday through Friday from 08:30 to 17:00 America/Chicago. If no qualified agent answers within 45 seconds, send the call to the General Support queue.

fallback_rules.trigger: No qualified agent accepts the conversation

instruction_text: During weekdays from 07:00 to 22:00 America/New_York, route messaging conversations tagged account-security and originating from the mobile app to English-speaking agents with account-security skills at priority 1. If no qualified agent accepts within 90 seconds, move the conversation to the Security Review queue.
